Capability: User drafts library entries field by field (material properties with temperature reference, section quantities, component fields) using catalog units, then applies them to the document.

Capability: Project validation preflight reports schema and version, round-trip categories, unit round-trip, model and envelope hash evidence, migration evidence and persistence operations, with JSON export.

Capability: Shows the design-agent workbench: selection, target, queue and boundary facts with Run, Propose, Review and Inspect actions and the active proposal summary.

Capability: Lets the user resize the table/canvas split and the table drawer by pointer or keyboard, close the inspector, and use slide-over drawers in narrow windows.
Notes: Handlers are provided by the workspace session in src/features (outside this area).

Capability: Exercises end-to-end user journeys: fixture solve and results, report, from-blank authoring, rule-pack, library and rule-check flows, warnings and boundaries.
Builds validated two-node 3D Euler-Bernoulli frame elements and their 12x12 local stiffness for axial, torsion and two bending planes (shear deformation excluded).
Notes: Zero external dependencies. Rejects nonfinite, nonpositive and degenerate inputs via a typed error enum. Base kernel reused by straight-pipe, curved-bend, supports, nonlinear loop and the product physics crate.

Capability: Defines the fixed six-DOF-per-node ordering [ux,uy,uz,rx,ry,rz] and helpers mapping node and element DOFs to global indices.
Notes: Re-exported by linear supports so downstream crates bind the same ordering rather than re-deriving offsets.

Capability: Transforms element stiffness from local to global axes using validated direction-cosine orientation, including construction from an x axis and y reference vector.
Notes: Invalid orientation (non-orthonormal or degenerate) is rejected, not corrected.

Capability: Accepts a caller-supplied 12x12 local stiffness as a two-node macro-element (for example an expansion-joint style element) and rotates it to global axes.
Notes: Values are opaque user inputs; no catalog or rating data supplied.

Capability: Assembles frame and user-stiffness element matrices into a dense global stiffness matrix.
Notes: Dense storage only; intended for small and moderate systems. Product physics calls the user-element variant directly.

Capability: Reduces the global system for restrained DOFs and adjusts the force vector for prescribed nonzero displacements.
Notes: Detects repeated restraints and out-of-range node/DOF indices.

Capability: Solves a reduced dense linear system by deterministic Gaussian elimination with partial pivoting and reports singular systems.
Notes: Internal zero-pivot guard is a verification guard, not a tolerance policy. Serves as the dense scrutiny path and the parity oracle for the sparse solver; product physics still calls it on some paths.

Capability: Carries caller-supplied unit-system and unit identifiers per canonical dimension and canonical model references at the solver boundary without converting units.
Notes: Metadata only; consumed by the performance harness, straight-pipe boundary metadata and diagnostics. Not used by the product physics crate.

Capability: Computes a deterministic reverse Cuthill-McKee DOF ordering from node adjacency or a matrix nonzero pattern to reduce profile and bandwidth.
Notes: Tie-breaking by (degree, original index); input adjacency symmetrized and deduplicated. Also called directly by product physics.

Capability: Stores a symmetric matrix in skyline (profile) form built from a dense matrix or sparse entries, optionally under a supplied ordering.
Notes: Reads only the lower triangle; symmetry is the caller's contract.

Capability: Factors a profile matrix by in-repo LDL-transpose with fixed operation order and solves by forward, diagonal and backward substitution.
Notes: Single-threaded, no pivot reordering; repeat-run bitwise identity asserted in tests. Zero external dependencies.

Capability: Orders, stores, factors and solves a symmetric system in one call from a dense matrix or sparse entries, returning ordering, profile and factorization observations.
Notes: The entries variant is on the live product and nonlinear-loop solve path. README integration-status text saying the product still uses the dense path is stale relative to the code.

Capability: Reports singular pivots in both ordered and original numbering, accepted-pivot extrema, a pivot-ratio conditioning proxy and nonpositive-pivot count and location.
Notes: The pivot ratio is a documented proxy, not a true condition number; no thresholds encoded.

Capability: Defines linear support families (anchor, guide, line stop, vertical support, spring, imposed displacement) with dimension-tagged quantities and optional unit metadata.
Notes: No support or catalog defaults supplied.

Capability: Prepares restrained DOFs, spring entries and imposed-displacement entries from linear supports, emitting findings for missing data, duplicates and invalid DOFs.
Notes: Called by product physics.

Capability: Applies prepared supports to a dense global system by adding spring stiffness to diagonals and reducing rigid restraints and imposed displacements.
Notes: Linear behaviour only; gap, one-way and friction behaviour are handled by the nonlinear support crates.

Capability: Builds a straight two-node pipe element from explicit area, second moments and torsion constant and exposes its frame stiffness.
Notes: No pipe dimension tables or material defaults. Used by product physics.

Capability: Computes mass-per-length and weight-per-length hooks for a straight pipe element from explicit mass and caller-supplied gravity.
Notes: Only the mechanics benchmark calls it outside the crate; product physics computes weight loads itself.

Capability: Converts uniform (full or partial-span, local or global) and point loads on a straight pipe into work-equivalent fixed-end nodal loads.
Notes: Product physics uses the spanned global variant.

Capability: Converts an explicit element axial force effect (e.g. restrained thermal or pressure thrust) into equivalent nodal loads and includes it in force recovery.
Notes: The axial force value is supplied by the caller; this crate does not derive it.

Capability: Recovers local element end forces and per-end resultants from element or global-model displacements, subtracting equivalent loads where supplied.
Notes: No sign reinterpretation or stress classification. Many overloads for span and axial-effect combinations.

Capability: Recovers internal force resultants at arbitrary stations and as station sweeps along a straight pipe span from end forces and applied span loads.
Notes: No product physics caller found; reached from the stress benchmark via stress recovery station inputs.

Capability: Binds straight-pipe numeric fields to a caller-supplied unit basis, mass, gravity and force-per-length unit metadata and canonical model references.
Notes: No caller outside the crate found.

Capability: Builds a two-node circular-arc bend element whose 12x12 stiffness comes from closed-form flexibility integrals scaled by user in-plane and out-of-plane flexibility factors.
Notes: Factors are opaque user numbers; no flexibility or stress-intensification formula supplied. Requires equidistant ends and included angle strictly inside (0, pi). Used by product physics and the nonlinear loop.

Capability: Computes consistent equivalent nodal loads for a uniform distributed load along a curved bend arc, matching the element flexibility.
Notes: Closed-form, no quadrature.

Capability: Computes consistent equivalent nodal loads for the outward radial pressure-imbalance wall load on a curved bend from a pressure-thrust magnitude.
Notes: Caller supplies thrust and applies the end-cap force pair; used by product physics.

Capability: Recovers section force resultants at any arc fraction of a curved bend, with or without distributed and radial pressure loads, and reports end tangents.
Notes: Used by product physics.

Capability: Defines solver diagnostic records (code, severity, source, class, remediation, provenance, affected and canonical references, units) and maps solver status to analysis-boundary status.
Notes: Solver statuses map only to incomplete or mechanics-solved under solver-result authority; never to rule-check or human-acceptance states.

Capability: Maps frame-kernel, sparse-solver, linear-support and primitive-load errors and findings into located solver diagnostics.
Notes: Sparse singular pivots carry stable reduced-DOF affected references.

Capability: Classifies a condition-ratio estimate against caller-supplied thresholds and turns sparse factorization reports into nonpositive-pivot warnings.
Notes: No thresholds encoded; outside tests only the performance harness calls these.

Capability: Produces convergence or nonconvergence diagnostics for iterative solves from iteration counts, residuals and tolerance.
Notes: Used by the nonlinear support classifier.

Capability: Emits explicit status diagnostics recording that sparse default promotion and solver tolerance policy values remain undecided.
Notes: The tolerance diagnostic fires from the nonlinear loop when convergence policy is unset; the sparse-status message may lag the code, which already defaults the nonlinear loop to sparse.

Capability: Defines nonlinear supports (one-way, gap, lift-off, friction) with explicit activation sense, gap direction, clearance, friction coefficient and unit metadata.
Notes: Clearance and coefficient re-validated at classification time so struct-literal callers cannot slip in zero defaults.

Capability: Classifies each nonlinear support as active, inactive, sticking or sliding from trial displacements and reactions and reports state changes, residual and convergence.
Notes: State-switched complementarity: engaged supports test reaction sign, released supports test penetration. Does not assemble or solve.

Capability: Builds report-facing active-set records (settings, support states, changes, diagnostics, assumptions, limitations) and maps nonlinear support errors to diagnostics.
Notes: Report-record and assumption helpers have no caller outside the crate; possibly unreached from product reports.

Capability: Solves a frame model with nonlinear supports by iterating assembly, restraint application, linear solve, reaction recovery and active-set classification until converged or capped.
Notes: Residual is the active-set state-change count. Linear ground springs supported via the springs variant, which product physics calls. Rejects nonfinite reactions or work.

Capability: Includes caller-supplied user-stiffness and curved-bend macro-element stiffness slots in each nonlinear iteration's assembly.
Notes: No straight-chord fallback for bends.

Capability: Selects the linear solve per iteration: sparse profile solve by default, dense when explicitly chosen, dense fallback after sparse failure, recording sparse parity evidence.
Notes: Sparse assembly uses direct reduced profile entries. Dense scrutiny mode still records sparse parity observations.

Capability: Applies a bounded tangential friction force at sliding supports using an explicit or support-reaction-derived normal force and the user friction coefficient.
Notes: No load-path or load-step friction history. A sliding seed defers convergence one iteration.

Capability: Recovers from a singular first iteration caused by inactive contact seeds by one all-active retrial, and identifies eligible potential contact DOFs.
Notes: Only one recovery is permitted and it is recorded as a warning; later singularity remains a failure. Product physics calls the eligibility helper.

Capability: Requires explicit convergence controls, emits visible diagnostics for unset tolerance policy and nonconvergence, and publishes loop identity, assumptions and limitations.
Notes: Identity and assumption text is consumed by product physics for result provenance.

Capability: Generates invented cantilever-chain and planar grid-frame benchmark models with public provenance posture and declared unit identifiers.
Notes: Synthetic models only; fixtures with non-public provenance are rejected.

Capability: Runs repeatable dense and sparse solves over benchmark fixtures, recording size, nonzeros, residual, repeatability, conditioning, parity, timing, storage and ordered diagnostics.
Notes: No crate or product path depends on the harness; it is exercised only by its own tests. Timing is environment dependent and no thresholds are asserted.

Capability: Observes sparse-versus-dense suitability over fixed grid size bands and records parity, residual, repeatability, pivot and pivot-ratio threshold statuses.
Notes: Python test inspects the harness source statically. Status constants in the file carry both a not-promoted dense-default label and a later promotion label.

Capability: Records a fixed set of sparse default-promotion observations with timing, storage, hardware metadata and a true condition number from a Jacobi eigenvalue routine, printable as JSON.
Notes: The example binary prints an evidence JSON record to stdout; true condition number is computed for the observation set only.

Capability: Defines primitive load categories (weight, pressure, thermal, imposed displacement, hydrotest, wind, seismic, occasional), targets, directions and dimension-tagged magnitudes.
Notes: No code load categories or combinations supplied.

Capability: Validates primitive loads and prepares nodal force, full or partial element uniform load and imposed displacement contributions for the frame boundary.
Notes: Called by product physics.

Capability: Lumps uniform force-per-length element loads to equivalent nodal forces using caller-supplied element span and connectivity.
Notes: Translational global loads only. Only the mechanics benchmark calls it outside the crate.

Capability: Assembles nodal load contributions into a deterministic global load vector sorted by node, DOF and source, returning no vector if any contribution is invalid.
Notes: Only the mechanics benchmark calls it outside the crate.

Capability: Prepares wind, seismic and occasional loads as explicit equivalent-static mechanics inputs when a basis or provenance reference is supplied.
Notes: No dynamic procedure. Only the mechanics benchmark calls it outside the crate.

Capability: Generates seismic equivalent-static uniform element loads as element mass per length times user per-axis factor times user gravity.
Notes: All factors user entered; no code coefficients. Called by product physics.

Capability: Generates wind equivalent-static uniform loads on user-marked spans as pressure times shape factor times exposed diameter, optionally over a partial extent.
Notes: No wind profile or exposure catalog. Called by product physics.

Capability: Derives straight-pipe axial effect forces from thermal loads (E*A*alpha*dT) and pressure loads (pressure times internal area) using explicit element properties.
Notes: Only the mechanics benchmark calls it outside the crate; product physics computes its own thermal and pressure effects.

Capability: Defines storage-neutral load boundary records: canonical dimension vocabulary rejecting retired aliases, unit metadata, schema bindings, payload and hash references, and load-case records.
Notes: Shared by the algebra, stress-recovery and user-load crates; the load-case record has no caller outside this crate. Records hash references but computes no hashes.

Capability: Reports primitive-load validation and load-vector assembly findings and maps them to storage-neutral diagnostic records with code, class, severity, source and remediation.
Notes: Diagnostic-record helpers have no caller outside the crate.

Capability: Combines compatible mechanics operands by a user-defined linear combination with explicit numeric factors.
Notes: No default or code combination factors. Called by product physics.

Capability: Subtracts one result state from another for compatible mechanics quantities.
Notes: Called by product physics.

Capability: Computes min, max or range envelopes over an ordered set of compatible result states.
Notes: Range-mode tokens are parsed by product physics input validation.

Capability: Dispatches algebra expressions, enforces operand and dimension compatibility, preserves analysis status, rejects human-approval status and builds result boundary records.
Notes: evaluate_expression and the boundary-record builder have no caller outside the crate; product physics dispatches the operations itself. No general expression parser.

Capability: Recovers mechanics stress components (axial, bending, torsional shear, thin-wall pressure membrane) and summaries from force resultants, section properties and optional pressure.
Notes: No code stress equations, allowables or indices. Called by product physics.

Capability: Recovers stresses at individual span stations and over station sweeps from straight-pipe station resultants.
Notes: Only the stress benchmark calls it outside the crate.

Capability: Computes mechanics-only component stress ranges between two recovered stress states, optionally recording the modulus basis each state used.
Notes: Modulus basis is carried verbatim, not resolved. Only the stress benchmark calls it outside the crate.

Capability: Validates unit metadata for stress inputs (rejecting force-per-length as a resultant), enforces status boundaries and builds recovered-stress result boundary records.

Capability: Converts user concentrated forces and moments at nodes and uniform or concentrated element loads into traceable DOF contributions and a global load vector.

Capability: Converts user element loads (with optional axial effects) into straight-pipe work-equivalent nodal loads via the straight-pipe element.

Capability: Builds user-load model boundary records and result-recovery hooks with explicit unit metadata, provenance, schema binding and payload and hash references.

Capability: Computes pipe section and mass properties (effective bore, area, second moment, section modulus, torsion constant, contents volume, masses) from user dimensions and densities.
Notes: Python module with no product runtime caller found; referenced by path from the stress benchmark as calculator provenance. No schedule or material tables.

Capability: Validates section inputs for presence, positivity, dimension and single consistent units, emits blocking diagnostics and marks outputs as derived from user data.
Notes: No unit conversion; mixed units block rather than convert.

Capability: Developer READMEs for each solver, load and section-property module describing scope, method, boundary and verification.

Capability: Runs the linear-static preview solve: validates and normalizes a preview model, builds the frame model, assembles stiffness, solves each load case and returns one mechanics envelope.

Capability: Defines the preview model and solve request wire shape (project, nodes, pipes, sections, components, supports, load cases, loads, combinations, materials) for deserialization.

Capability: Defines the mechanics result envelope: separate status boundaries, located result items with basis and sign-convention metadata, diagnostics and a no-professional-claim boundary.
Notes: Blocked envelopes carry diagnostics and no solved rows.

Capability: Blocks a preview solve before mechanics when required collections, identifiers, provenance, units, hanger, component, thermal or combination inputs are missing or invalid.

Capability: Normalizes authored coordinates and quantities to canonical units at the mechanics boundary and blocks missing, unknown or dimensionally incompatible units.
Resolves pipe references to shared section definitions and blocks stale, blank or failed references while keeping local section inputs.
Notes: Cached section copies must match the referenced definition exactly.

Capability: Derives pipe section properties and mass per length from diameter and wall, reducing the wall by a user mill tolerance when present.
Notes: No default tolerance is applied.

Capability: Maps supports to rigid per-DOF restraints and springs by family (anchor, guide, line stop, vertical, spring) and blocks unknown family tokens or fewer than six ground DOFs.
Notes: The six-DOF count is a necessary lower bound only; the assembled solve decides stability. No automatic boundary conditions are added.

Capability: Solves gap, lift-off, friction and contact supports through an iterative active-set loop and reports support states, residual observations and convergence evidence.
Notes: Loop limits and residual tolerances are fixed in-file constants; several limits are zero or provisional observation thresholds.

Capability: Supplies the friction normal reaction either from an explicit user value or derived from a named support reaction and reports it as separate evidence.
Notes: Friction normal evidence is excluded from load combinations.

Capability: Lets the caller choose a sparse interactive or dense scrutiny linear solve and records solver-mode, sparse live-path and parity evidence with fallback diagnostics.
Notes: Sparse interactive is the default. The mode reaches users through the desktop solver-mode solve commands.

Capability: Converts authored primitive loads (nodal forces and moments, full and partial-span uniform loads, global or local directions) into element and nodal mechanics loads.
Applies thermal expansion as equivalent element loads with fixed-end axial correction, requiring an explicit material expansion coefficient.
Notes: Authored thermal load direction does not affect magnitude or sign.

Capability: Applies internal pressure thrust as axial element loads from genuine pressure records only, summing multiple records once and ignoring hydrotest-dimension records.
Generates seismic and wind equivalent-static distributed or nodal loads from user gravity, density, factors and marked exposed spans, blocking when inputs are missing or overlap.
